headline_real: Svedka's 'Shake Your Bots Off' becomes the first primarily AI-generated national Super Bowl ad
facts: Svedka's 30-second 'Shake Your Bots Off' aired in Super Bowl LX on Feb 8, 2026 as the first primarily AI-generated national Super Bowl spot

Produced with San Francisco AI studio Silverside — the same firm behind Coca-Cola's contentious 2025 AI holiday video — taking roughly four months to reconstruct the 'Fembot' character and train AI on facial expressions and body movement
Part of a Super Bowl LX AI-ad wave that also included Anthropic, Google (Nano Banana Pro), Meta/Oakley, Amazon Alexa+ and Wix

headline_real: Coachella and Google DeepMind built and tested three AI prototypes at the 2026 festival
facts: Coachella's innovation team built three prototypes on Google DeepMind's Project Genie world-model platform, tested live during the April 2026 festival

One prototype rebuilds a live performance as an explorable 3D Unreal Engine environment with real-time alternate visuals; a second lets artists preview stage designs from uploaded images or text prompts on 3D models of Coachella stages; a third is a mobile game
Reported April 26, 2026; the tools remain internal proofs-of-concept, not publicly launched

headline_real: IBM's 'AI Sports Club' turns generative AI into live race commentary at SXSW 2026
facts: IBM ran its 'AI Sports Club' as SXSW 2026's Tech & AI Track sponsor in Austin, March 12-18, 2026

The Hyperdrive Slot Car Challenge pitted four players head-to-head with AI-generated, real-time race commentary and analysis; an F1 simulator ran on IBM watsonx, the same stack behind the Scuderia Ferrari app's 400M+ global fan base
Guests generated personalized 'AI Sports Club Pass' badges under an 'Enter a fan, leave a driver' theme

headline_real: 2026 F1 Miami Grand Prix: 17 Full-Throttle Brand Experiences
facts: The fifth-year Miami Grand Prix (race May 3, 2026) drew an estimated 275,000 attendees
American Express built a two-story Amex Racing Club in the F1 Fan Zone plus a Platinum-only Trackside Lounge near the start/finish line
Liquid I.V. x McLaren sampled 97,000 hydration sticks over the weekend from a branded Hydratruck at Regatta Harbour (McLaren fan zone open April 29-May 3)
Monster Energy reached more than 25,000 fans, anchored by a 20-foot Lando Norris Zero Sugar can installation

headline_real: Top Brand Activations From Coachella 2026
facts: Pinterest debuted a first-of-its-kind phone-free experience on the festival grounds, with e.l.f.-powered beauty touch-ups
Heineken returned with Heineken House for its 23rd year as official beer sponsor; Aperol ran its Aperol Day Club for a 4th year as official spritz partner
Magnum served as Coachella's first-ever frozen dessert sponsor with a spray-bar activation in the 12 Peaks VIP area
Barbie's 'You Can Be Any Barbie!' near the main entrance featured a charm bar, portrait studio and a hologram entrance

headline_real: SXSW 2026: 18 Experiential Ideas and Themes Worth Stealing
facts: Rivian built an Electric Roadhouse plus a 245-foot off-road test track along a 270-foot Congress Avenue stretch, offering expert-led rides in the new R2 SUV (March 13-15)
McDonald's 'First Job Confessional' kiosks (March 15-17) paid participants $15 gift cards to record first-job stories
Nikon's ATX pop-up (March 12-18) debuted the ZR cinema camera with photo walks, portrait sessions and workshops
Blumhouse's first-ever horror community meetup at Swift's Attic (March 14) sold out at ~150 guests with a 23-category trivia competition

headline_real: The Best Beauty Pop-Ups of 2026: From Ski Slopes to Grand Central
facts: K18 staged a Hair Flip Challenge at NYC's Grand Central Terminal, driving 1.9M impressions, sampling 5,000 masks and donating $100K
rhode built a 'Snow Club' winter ecosystem with a retail Snow Station in Big Sky, Montana
MCoBeauty ran an immersive escape-room activation across 30 Escapology locations, expecting 37,000 participants
Kayali opened a 2-day café experience inside an Airstream trailer in SoHo, NYC

headline_real: Garden Studios unveils its most advanced virtual production stage with a fully motorised, tilting LED ceiling
facts: Fully motorised LED ceiling uses 2.6mm pixel-pitch Absen panels and tilts up to 90 degrees to act as a front wall, forming a full 360-degree volume
Ceiling travels up to 18 metres front-to-back and doubles the ceiling area of the studio's previous stage
Runs Unreal Engine-based real-time workflows and covers roughly 90% of camera angles with a single 180-degree rotation, cutting downtime between setups

headline_real: Television City and Orbital Studios partner on a new Hollywood virtual production studio and R&D lab
facts: New LED volume virtual production facility opens at 7800 Beverly Blvd. in LA's Fairfax District on the historic Television City lot (bought by Hackman Capital in 2018 for $750 million)
Orbital Studios (founded 2020 by A.J. Wedding) brings camera tracking, real-time rendering and an in-house Virtual Art Department to a full-service stage plus R&D lab
Orbital's roadmap spans AI-assisted content creation and location reconstruction via 3D Gaussian Splatting; recent credits include the docuseries 'World War II With Tom Hanks'

headline_real: Clear Angle Studios launches a modular Volumetric Capture Rig for dynamic Gaussian splat performances
facts: Rig uses 40 high-speed machine-vision cameras with 6K sensors shooting 12-bit at 60fps, plus 450 individually programmable light nodes and up to 120 lighting configurations
Scalable capture volume reaches 2.5 cubic meters with 360-degree coverage, and is based at Pinewood Studios in Buckinghamshire, England
Dynamic Gaussian splat capture preserves original performance behavior and natural lighting, cutting manual post steps; Union VFX partnered on re-lighting solutions for the splat assets

headline_real: Inside Arcturus' dynamic Gaussian splat capture behind MrBeast's 500M-subscriber video
facts: Volumetric studio Arcturus reconstructed the 'Floor is Lava' sequence as a dynamic Gaussian splat, letting editors scout virtual camera moves after filming wrapped
Capture used only 30 to 35 cameras per shot inside a plexiglass cube, relying on depth supervision and multiview-consistent pruning to handle constant occlusion from fast-moving contestants
8 takes were processed and 3 made the final cut; the video marked MrBeast crossing 500 million YouTube subscribers on June 12, 2026

headline_real: Metallica Announce 24-Show 'Life Burns Faster' Sphere Las Vegas Residency
facts: 24 performances run October 2026 through March 2027, all at 8:30 PM
Uses a 'No Repeat Weekend' format where Thursday and Saturday setlists share no songs
Built for Sphere's wraparound highest-resolution LED display and multi-sensory 4D technology
Original ticket allocation sold out, pushing shows to resale on Ticketmaster and StubHub

headline_real: ILLENIUM Turns Sphere Into a 'Neo-Space Opera' With Nine-Night ODYSSEY Residency
facts: Nine shows across March 5-7, 12-14 and April 2-4, 2026 — only the second electronic act at Sphere after Anyma
Berlin's Woodblock Animation Studios built the narrative with 65 animators working in Houdini
Content mapped to Sphere's 160,000-square-foot wraparound interior LED screen
Visuals follow a two-warrior light-vs-dark story tied to his album ODYSSEY (out Feb 6, 2026, Republic Records)

headline_real: Tomorrowland Unveils 'Consciencia,' Its Most Ambitious Mainstage Ever
facts: Stage stands 43 metres tall and 140 metres wide, centered on a sculpted face named Amutaz
Built from 2,400 LED tiles, 1,200 lighting fixtures (300 custom), 56 lasers, 38 fountains, 2 waterfalls and 7 giant inflatable faces
Took over two years from first sketch to opening night, plus 54 days of on-site construction
Theme spans six 'provinces,' each mapped to a human emotion — wonder, joy, desire, love, anger, sadness

headline_real: Soda Stereo Take a Touring Digital Frontman on the Road With the ECOS Tour
facts: A hyperrealistic digital avatar of late singer Gustavo Cerati (d. 2014) performs live alongside surviving members Zeta Bosio and Charly Alberti
Uses hyperrealistic renderings plus archival audio rather than AI-generated movement or synthetic vocals, unlike fixed installs such as ABBA Voyage
Fully modular and touring — 14 countries, nearly two dozen cities, 450,000-plus tickets sold, with a September U.S. leg (San Jose, LA, Las Vegas, Chicago, NY, Miami)
Creative-directed by Nicolas Bernaudo, with roughly two-hour shows

headline_real: Cleveland Museum of Art opens 'ArtLens Reimagined,' a gallery driven by locally-run AI trained only on its own collection
facts: Opened July 28, 2026 as a 10,000-square-foot space with 21 new interactive experiences
Uses locally-run AI models trained exclusively on the museum's own collection; 'Infinite Landscape' generates AI scenery on a 24-foot curved wall

Organized into five themed zones - Relate, Investigate, Create, Explore and Infinite Landscape, with Chief Digital Innovation officer Jane Alexander framing tech as 'the bridge that helps people engage more deeply'

headline_real: FIFA and Gamefam launch FIFA World Cup 2026 event in Super Soccer on Roblox
facts: Official FIFA World Cup 2026 event launched Friday, June 5, 2026 and runs through July 31, 2026 across Roblox
All 48 World Cup national teams are playable in FIFA Super Soccer, including reigning champion Argentina
Six-game crossover spanning Gamefam's Roblox titles that record a combined 28 million gameplay sessions per week; FIFA calls it the platform's biggest sports event ever

headline_real: Lil Tecca to headline Fortnite Festival season 15
facts: Fortnite Festival Season 15 went live July 30, 2026 with Lil Tecca as the headline artist
Four Lil Tecca jam tracks added in-game: 'Ransom', 'Dark Thoughts', 'Love Me' and '500lbs'
The Neon Dreams Music Pass unlocks the music-reactive Tour Ready Lil Tecca Outfit, Mic Mace Pickaxe and Tecca's World Back Bling; he is the first rap headliner since Snoop Dogg in early 2024

headline_real: Minecraft Experience tops one million visitors as Moonlight Trail debuts
facts: Minecraft Experience surpassed 1 million visitors worldwide since its 2024 debut, spanning North America, Europe, Latin America and Asia
Moonlight Trail, the franchise's first outdoor nighttime attraction with eight interactive biomes, opened May 15, 2026 at Ciudad Universitaria in Buenos Aires
Produced by Experience MOD with Mojang Studios and creative studio Supply + Demand; the indoor Villager Rescue has toured cities including Dallas, Chicago, Mexico City, Singapore and Vienna

headline_real: How game publishers activated at San Diego Comic-Con 2026: Supercell, Discord, Alienware and Google Play
facts: Supercell built 'Clash for the Stache,' a 10-minute puzzle Challenge Room at Seaport Village (via GDX Studios) held open to non-attendees through Sept 7
Discord and Sony ran a 'Resident Evil' scavenger hunt through a Raccoon City indoor-outdoor build at Quartyard using Discord's Mission Quest feature (Sawhorse Productions)

Alienware ran a gaming lounge with a surprise 60-second trivia game show for a laptop and 39-inch 5K OLED monitor; Google Play's 'The Auction' let fans earn tokens to bid on ultra-rare gaming collectibles, hosted by Quenlin Blackwell

headline_real: Vivid Sydney 2026 expands to day and night with record drone shows and its tallest-ever installation
facts: Runs 22 May-13 June 2026 across 23 nights, with an unbroken 6.5km Light Walk of 40+ installations
Chris Levine's 'Molecule of Light' is the tallest work in festival history at 23m high x 17m wide, visible across Sydney Harbour; Reelize Studio's 'Obstacle' is among the longest ever at 45m
Record 22 drone shows across 11 nights at Cockle Bay; festival has drawn 25M+ visitors and $1.3B+ in visitor spend since inception

headline_real: Robotic art and AI-driven installations lead Sonar+D 2026 in Barcelona
facts: Sonar+D 2026 runs 18-19 June in Barcelona's neoclassical Llotja de Mar, foregrounding embodied robotics, AI interfaces and site-specific LED visuals
Volvox Labs' 'Astral Twin' pairs robotic arms painting in dialogue with a giant LED wall; Qs Ventures' 'A Voice from the Future' is a moss-covered phone booth inhabited by an AI persona
Installations deploy AI tools including Google DeepMind's Lyria 3 for generative soundscapes

headline_real: 80,000 visitors swarm 'TOKYO LIGHTS' projection mapping and light art event
facts: TOKYO LIGHTS 2026 drew 80,000 visitors over 23-31 May, projecting onto the 127m-tall, 110m-wide facade of the Tokyo Metropolitan Government No.1 Building
The '1minute Projection Mapping Competition' received 412 entries from 65 countries and regions, narrowed to 18 finalists
Brazilian group Signal Bleed won the grand prize (2 million yen) for 'Touch Talk'; a paired Light Art Park featured 12 works including Luke Jerram's GAIA

headline_real: Sphere Entertainment announces intent to develop a smaller-scale Sphere at National Harbor near Washington, D.C.
facts: Announced 18 Jan 2026: a second U.S. Sphere near Washington, D.C., and the first to use a smaller-scale model, seating 6,000
Interior features a 16K x 16K LED display plane (billed as the world's highest-resolution screen), plus an Exosphere exterior, Sphere Immersive Sound, haptic seating and 4D effects
Backed by ~$200M in combined incentives, projected to support 2,500 construction and 4,750 operational jobs with $1B+ annual economic impact

headline_real: Meta and EssilorLuxottica launch new 'Meta Glasses' AI eyewear line starting at $299
facts: Launched June 23, 2026 starting at $299 — about $80 cheaper than Ray-Ban Meta Gen 2
Three styles: Meta Adventurer, Meta Fury, and Meta Glasses by Kylie (Kylie Jenner collab, from ~$399)
Runs Meta AI on the new Muse Spark model, 12MP ultrawide camera, 8+ hours battery plus 40 hours from the charging case
New Rx Lens Swap lets buyers add prescription lenses after purchase without voiding warranty; sold across 17 markets via Meta.com, LensCrafters, Sunglass Hut, Best Buy and Amazon

headline_real: visionOS 27 gives Apple Vision Pro a spatial computing and Apple Intelligence upgrade
facts: Announced at WWDC 2026; adds Spatial Panoramas that convert flat panoramas into stepable 3D environments
New Spatial Siri 3D widget enables hands-free AI interaction with no wake word
Adds Spatial Reframing AI photo editing, curved app windows, a Mac Virtual Display widget and Wi-Fi 3x faster
Apple Intelligence gains contextual understanding of objects seen through passthrough, plus 360-degree web experiences in Safari

headline_real: Google and Samsung confirm Android XR glasses launching Fall 2026 with Warby Parker and Gentle Monster
facts: Google and Samsung officially teased first Android XR glasses styles for a Fall 2026 launch
Eyewear partners are Warby Parker and Gentle Monster for fashion-forward frames
Gemini-powered: real-time translation, navigation, restaurant ordering, summarized notifications and hands-free photo capture
Audio-first frames ship first; full-display versions expected to follow in 2027

headline_real: Snap brings AI Lenses to luxury fashion as Gucci launches 'La Famiglia' Sponsored AI Lens
facts: Gucci's 'La Famiglia' is the first Sponsored AI Lens for a luxury fashion brand, powered by Snapchat's generative AI
Transforms users into collection-based character personas (L'Incazzata, Direttore, La VIP, Il Figo, Principino)
Snap says ~90% of 13-24-year-olds globally use the app and ~80% of users report AR experiences help purchase decisions
Follows Snap's 2025 holiday luxury push with Chopard, BOSS and Lancome; Gen Z projected to be 25%+ of global luxury spend within four years

headline_real: Lightroom and Aardman announce 'Larger Than Life,' a 360-degree immersive show starring Wallace & Gromit, Shaun and Morph
facts: Opens 14 October 2026 at Lightroom, London and runs through 4 January 2027
50-minute looping show projected across Lightroom's four 11-metre-tall walls plus the floor
Marks Aardman's 50th anniversary; tickets GBP 25 adults / GBP 15 children and students

headline_real: AREA15 signs more world-class tenants, with 12+ new immersive experiences opening across 2026
facts: More than 12 new experiences slated to open at AREA15 Las Vegas during 2026
Includes the largest-ever Museum of Ice Cream (with a world-first ice cream buffet), iFLY indoor skydiving and The Bowl restaurant featuring robot chefs
Adds House Rules competitive-socialising venue and a Miniso flagship, following Universal Horror Unleashed and Felix & Paul's Interstellar Arc

headline_real: ARTECHOUSE Houston opens 'Blooming Wonders,' an AI-driven interactive digital garden
facts: On view 6 March through 13 September 2026 at ARTECHOUSE Houston, the largest in its US network at 26,000 sq ft
Motion-responsive projections make flowers bloom underfoot, plus a cascading flower-petal Infinity Room
'Clay Pillar' installation generates real-time AI visuals triggered by visitors' spoken voice prompts

headline_real: Media Cymru premieres immersive works 'Artio' and 'Awen: Unbound' at Outernet London
facts: Two Welsh-made immersive works premiere at Outernet London, with the launch event on 4 March 2026 and public showings from March 2026

'Artio' is an interactive Arthurian 'musical mythscape' using gesture recognition and generative visuals; 'Awen: Unbound' uses light, sound and real Welsh environmental data with plant-generated music
Outernet London draws 6M+ visitors annually as the city's most-visited cultural attraction
